messages:
maria: opened a PR to clarify warm-start vs eviction behavior in the dedicated provisioning guide. short goal: avoid implying warm_start prevents preemption and add burst_policy examples. PR: #3489

leo: nice. can you add an ops note about how reserved pools + tenant priority interact with burst_policy? folks keep assuming reserved pools = no evictions.

maria: yep. planning a 2-line callout: 'Reserved pools provide stronger isolation; combine with tenant_priority to reduce eviction risk. Warm-start only reduces cold latency.'

alex: also add a tiny CLI example for the infra folks. quick: `rictl provision create --tenant=t-123 --model=gpt-small --warm-start --burst-policy=reserved_only`

maria: good idea. i'll include that and an equivalent SDK snippet.

rachael: small wording ask  we call it "eviction" consistently? some docs say "preemption" elsewhere. pick one and add an alias note.

leo: yes, canonicalize to 'eviction' and mention '(also called preemption in older guides)'. keeps searchers happy.

docs-bot: running link/anchor check for /dedicated/provisioning...

docs-bot: found 2 issues: 1) internal anchor `/dedicated/autoscale#policy-table` -> should be `/dedicated/provisioning#burst-policy`. 2) broken relative link to `../runtime/eviction` (404)  suggested `/eng-runtime/eviction-overview`. Commented on PR #3489.

maria: thanks bot. i'll update links and add a short footnote pointing to the eviction overview for details on ordering and tenant priority.

alex: for the YAML examples we should show 3 variants: reserved_only, allow_burst, and hybrid with burst_capacity_pct. users love concrete numbers.

maria: drafting YAML now. snippet:```yaml
provisioning:
  warm_start: true
  burst_policy: reserved_only  # never use cluster burst capacity; favors reserved pools
  tenant_priority: high
  sla:
    latency_p95_ms: 300
```

maria: and an allow_burst variant:```yaml
provisioning:
  warm_start: true
  burst_policy: allow_burst  # permits temporary use of shared capacity during spikes
  burst_capacity_pct: 30
  tenant_priority: medium
  sla:
    latency_p95_ms: 350
```

leo: perfect. also add a one-sentence SLO measurement tip: 'When comparing token latency across configs, exclude retry/migration attempts caused by eviction to avoid skew.'

maria: added that. also added the SDK one-liner: `await client.dedicated.provision({tenantId: 't-123', model: 'gpt-small', warmStart: true, burstPolicy: 'allow_burst'})`

rachael: skimmed PR. two tiny nits: 1) replace 'guarantee' with 'reduce' in the intro; 2) move the CLI example into a separate "Ops quick commands" section so it doesn't clutter the YAML.

maria: done. pushed.

docs-bot: PR #3489 link-check re-run: no remaining anchor issues. auto-commented that staging build shows updated page.

deploy-bot: PR #3489 merged by maria at 1764114800 and deployed to staging docs. :shipit:

leo: great, thanks all. I'll queue a short heads-up in #eng-runtime about the eviction link change so infra folks aren't surprised.
